why_ai: Congregants come for a pastor and a gathered community; pastoral care is personal and consequential.
why_clarity: Services recur weekly, but spiritual success is a matter of faith and never objectively checked.
why_digital: Worship, care and volunteering happen in person in a local building.

why_ai: Accreditation decides insurability, and judging abuse risk in institutions is consequential and accountable.
why_clarity: Assessments follow standards, but whether abuse was prevented is rarely observable.
why_digital: Policies and site practices are assessed into written reports and online training.

why_ai: Field linguists must live among speakers of undocumented languages; AI cannot gather that record.
why_clarity: Documentation methods are standard, but every language is a new, multi-year project.
why_digital: Work starts in remote communities and ends as freely published documentation.

why_ai: Feasibility rests on interviewing members in person and coaching leaders through an emotional ask.
why_clarity: Dollars raised measure success under a codified method, but results arrive after the campaign.
why_digital: Member interviews and on-site campaign management, sold to congregations nationally.

why_ai: Assessing whether a building fits a ministry needs site visits and judgment from accumulated experience.
why_clarity: Each building and ministry is different and the plan's value shows years later.
why_digital: Starts from physical buildings; delivers space plans and recommendations.

why_ai: The only real congregational giving dataset is a moat, but the analytics work automates.
why_clarity: In-product analytics and benchmarks are well-specified data products.
why_digital: Giving and attendance data processed into analytics inside software.

why_ai: Borrowers file no public financials, so lenders judge leadership stability and attendance through relationships.
why_clarity: Credit decisions are defined, but repayment outcomes take years and borrowers are idiosyncratic.
why_digital: Underwriting runs on collected financials, with denominational relationships and some site visits.

why_ai: Licensed teachers physically care for young children, which parents entrust only to known people.
why_clarity: Daily routines recur under licensing rules, but child development outcomes are slow and soft.
why_digital: Care is delivered in person in church classrooms to local families.

why_ai: Accountable underwriters and actuaries price abuse and liability exposures from unique claim data.
why_clarity: Rating is codified across many similar policies, but claims emerge over years.
why_digital: Claims data analysed on screens, with risk control guidance and agent-led sales.

why_ai: Compiling annual statistics and trend analyses is work AI tools absorb easily.
why_clarity: Annual reports are compiled the same way each cycle, but planting decisions pay off slowly.
why_digital: Congregational reports in, statistics out, within a denomination.

why_ai: Booking and invoicing automate, but someone must open, set up and secure the building.
why_clarity: Bookings, contracts and insurance checks are standard and visibly succeed or fail.
why_digital: The product is use of a physical hall, rented to local groups.

why_ai: Central operations automate, but campus pastoral care and ministry need local leaders.
why_clarity: Weekly services and central functions repeat, but ministry impact is unmeasured.
why_digital: Worship happens on physical campuses, with streaming and central systems alongside.

why_ai: Imams, shura councils and community mediation are interpersonal and rooted in local trust.
why_clarity: Daily prayers and zakat follow fixed rules, but community wellbeing is not measurable.
why_digital: Prayer, classes and community services happen in person in the centre.

why_ai: Campus dashboards and site analyses by tiny teams are standard analytics AI handles.
why_clarity: Attendance and giving metrics are defined, though expansion bets take years to judge.
why_digital: Attendance and giving data analysed into reports on screens.

why_ai: Structuring public returns is automatable, but funder-contributed grant data and brand help.
why_clarity: Filings are classified and structured the same way every season.
why_digital: Public filings in, structured data and ratings out, sold online.

why_ai: Members seek real pastors and fellow believers online, which AI content cannot stand in for.
why_clarity: Weekly streams recur, but spiritual community building has no objective measure.
why_digital: Services, groups and prayer requests run entirely online, open to anyone anywhere.

why_ai: AI can generate lesson content, though doctrinal trust in the publisher slows the shift.
why_clarity: Curricula follow developmental frameworks, but teaching quality is judged subjectively.
why_digital: Content is written on screens and shipped as print and digital resources.

why_ai: Long-running survey series give comparability AI cannot fake, but analysis and writing automate.
why_clarity: Tracking study methods repeat, but research value is a matter of client judgment.
why_digital: Surveys in, reports out, sold remotely.

why_ai: Grant-funded national surveys and archives persist, though analysis is increasingly automatable.
why_clarity: Survey methods are rigorous, but research findings are validated only by the field over years.
why_digital: Survey data in, archives and published research out.

why_ai: Bivocational pastors and volunteers serve neighbours they know, in person.
why_clarity: Weekly worship recurs, but congregational health has no objective measure.
why_digital: Paper bulletins and word of mouth; most have no functional website.

why_ai: Pledge reminders and fulfilment tracking are rule-based, though the pastor's ask carries weight.
why_clarity: Pledged versus given amounts are exact and tracked on recurring cycles.
why_digital: Giving runs through online platforms, with appeals made from the pulpit.

why_ai: Scheduling volunteers against availability is a constraint problem software solves directly.
why_clarity: Weekly rosters repeat and a filled or unfilled slot is obvious immediately.
why_digital: Availability data in, schedules out, for volunteers in one congregation.
